necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary arteries, coded as R55 and I25.10. Given the concern for intermittent arrhythmia as the underlying etiology of these collapse events, mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to capture continuous rhythm data during symptomatic periods. This clinical indication supports the medical necessity of the service despite the denial based on Reason Code CO-197 for missing precertification.
